title: Does not come in Red !!
text:
Does not come in Red !!. This Lenox heart dish is ok, but how does any company make a heart dish that does not come in Red?

This is stoneware , not fine China.

product_metadata.title: Lenox French Perle Thyme Heart Dish
features: Available in 10 fun colors - white, ice blue, pistachio, violet, lavender, lilac, bluebell, peacock, chambray, thyme
The rim features a hand-applied tea stain finish.
Backed by a lifetime breakage replacement program from Lenox.
description: Show your love of entertaining with this beautiful heart-shaped dish. Sized for ease and versatility, this dish can hold anything from your favorite candy to your jewelry or your car keys. An elegant accessory, this dish will make every occasion feel special and it makes a really thoughtful gift.
